    }

  "claims": [
    {
      "id": "c:5918463449",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "question",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "whether replacement peers should be validated to ensure they actually do useful work before evicting existing peers",
      "quote": "Would we want to do more validation of those claims before evicting someone?",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "author replied that replacements cannot do worse than peers explicitly refusing tx relay and outlined alternative tweaks",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:6985315949"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "c:6985315949",
      "status_by_quote": "The replacement peer makes the same claims as every other full outbound peer we connect to while the evicted peer has told us that it will drop our transactions."
    },
    {
      "id": "c:5918463449",
      "part": 2,
      "type": "question",
      "kind": "usefulness",
      "text": "whether there is evidence on the network that non-tx-relaying peers are a real problem",
      "quote": "do we have evidence this is a real problem? ... Can we crawl the network to see evidence of this?",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "author ran a crawler across network peers finding ~0.8% advertise relay=0",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:6985315949",
        "c:6986788944"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "c:6986788944",
      "status_by_quote": "So the share on Tor is even smaller than on clearnet and the KIT data matches the result closely."
    },
    {
      "id": "c:5951741726",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "text": "the functional test checks for non-eviction cannot fail because a node never evicts the only peer on a network",
      "quote": "The \"not evicted\" checks in the first and third cases of the new `p2p_blocksonly.py` test can't fail.",
      "clears_with": "change",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author adopted the suggested test changes with minor edits",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:6985315949"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "c:6985315949",
      "status_by_quote": "I took the suggested test changes mostly with a few edits."
    },
    {
      "id": "r:5502202695",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "question",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "whether active peers that do not relay transactions should be prioritized over peers that relay transactions but have been silent for some time",
      "quote": "Shouldn't we chose the peer that is active over the one that has been silent for some time even if the active peer is not relaying transactions?",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "author explained last block announcement only arbitrates among peers of the same kind and stale tip logic handles silent peers",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:6985315949"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "c:6985315949",
      "status_by_quote": "The last block announcement only decides between peers of the same kind. A tx relaying peer that stays silent is still handled by the chain sync and stale tip logic"
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:4257881028",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "maintenance",
      "text": "add a test case to denialofservice_tests checking that a replacement is requested even when the candidate peer cannot be evicted yet because it is younger than MINIMUM_CONNECT_TIME",
      "quote": "I think it would be good to add a new test case here to check that a replecemnt is requested even when the candidate with `m_relays_txs=false` cannot be evicted yet because it is younger than MINIMUM_",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author added a check in denialofservice_tests where the test already passed through that state",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:4617617964",
        "c:6985315949"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:4617617964",
      "status_by_quote": "I added a check for this but it could be done simpler than you suggested because the test already passes through this state so I added just the check in the right place."
    }
  ],
  "support": [
    {
      "id": "r:5344753685",

      "evidence": "read",

  "notes": "The author answered questions from instagibbs and Bicaru20, provided network crawl statistics on relay=0 nodes, and pushed test changes addressing the concerns of fametrano and Bicaru20.",
  "waiting_on": [
    {
      "on": "reviewer",
